notes: G2 wave 5, packet P6b33d56e4e. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Garruk, Savage Herald, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' I accept the may and search only my graveyard (option 2): the Herald goes from the graveyard to my hand. I did not search my library, so it is NOT shuffled: it keeps its setup order (the runner's six fillers on top, then Keep Two, Keep One). 'drawn' is listed last so the runner's opening draw puts it in hand: hand after = drawn + Herald = 2.
